text: Always nice chatting with you, Sheldon. Finley Vale, contempt.

text: Sarcasm? Remember, seven o'clock. Pacific Daylight Time.

text: Please reserve that butch spirit for the lanes.

text: I thought you were bringing your own bowling shoes. These are my own bowling shoes.

text: I know where my feet have been. Hey, Penny. And you guys. Albino Bob couldn't make it, so I brought a substitute. I believe some of you know Will Wheaton.

text: Well, well, well, if it isn't Will Wheaton. The Green Goblin to my Spider-Man. The Pope of all the Fith to my Galileo. The Internet Explorer to my Firefox.

text: Hi, Sheldon. How's it going? You're not still carrying a grudge because I beat you at that card tournament, are you?

text: I'm the proud owner of willwheatonstinks.com.net and .org. What does that tell you? It tells me that I am living rent-free right here.

text: Oh, I'm ready. I don't know if Stuart told you what you're up against tonight, but before you stands the co-captain of the East Texas Christian Youth Holy Roller Bowling League Championship team. Seven to twelve-year-old division.
